corpora.raw_data_distribution: not bundled; local git checkout only
corpora.role: derived document-level source-code benchmark, not an exact-span or upstream secret annotation

positive.document_rule: whole UTF-8 file is a positive source-code document; it produces no exact span Gold

negative.document_rule: non-code document negative; report document false positives separately

corpora.verification: git rev-parse HEAD must equal revision; LICENSE SHA-256 must equal license_file_sha256; source selection is sorted relative path.
corpora.leakage_limit: This repository implements secret-detection rules and tests. It is acceptable only for document-type behavior, never as neutral code or secret-recall evidence.

corpora.license: SchemaPile-Perm: files selected from 193 permissive licenses (MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/CC0 etc.)
corpora.role: derived exact SQL-statement content Gold, not an upstream DLP annotation

positive.span_rule: lexically terminated semicolon statement, excluding delimiter whitespace; exact character offsets in its source SQL file
positive.selection: archive member name order, then statement offset order

negative.rule: all 214 Go documents are SQL-negative documents; report SQL false positives separately

corpora.verification: SHA-256 and the publisher-provided MD5 must match before extracting. The archive must contain only UTF-8 .sql members selected by the adapter.
corpora.caveat: SchemaPile-Perm reports permissive repository-license filtering using GitHub metadata. Preserve source provenance and do not use it where an individual-repository license audit is required.

excluded_note: ProwlBench is intentionally outside this manifest and target coverage because of its noncommercial license. SecretBench requires controlled access/DPA; CodeSearchNet has per-row upstream licenses; LogHub states research/academic use; sql-create-context lacks sufficient commercial provenance. None is an admitted Golden source.
